title: 第 三章 双灵根第 四章 溯源鼎
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
陆行舟转而看向陆峰，神色变得和蔼起来。
“你既然年纪符合检测要求，我便带你去进行灵根检测。”
说罢，他便转身朝着玲珑阁内走去。
陆峰眼中瞬间闪过惊喜与感激之色，赶忙小跑着跟了上去。
“你在这儿稍等片刻，我去去就回。”陆行舟转头对着陆峰说道。
随后，他来到另一个房间。
只见房门前的光幕流转着淡淡的灵光，边缘处隐隐有符文闪烁。
这里布置着一套一品中阶防御阵法，守护着房间内的重要物件。
陆行舟敛息凝神，对着光幕打入一丝灵力。
光幕微微泛起涟漪，随后缓缓打开一个缺口，他这才踏入其中。
房间内的空间并不大，只摆放着一张古朴的供台，上面放置着一个测灵盘。
这测灵盘乃是一阶上品法器，仅能用于灵根测试。
可当初为了购置它，陆家也是花费了两百多块灵石，在陆家算得上是高价值的物品了。
陆峰见陆行舟许久都没回来，便开始好奇地打量起周围的一切。
毕竟，年仅六岁的他，对从未见过的事物都充满了好奇。
他瞧见桌子上放着一个精致的玉瓶，忍不住拿起来仔细端详。
看了半天，也没看出个所以然，又把玉瓶放在耳边轻轻摇晃，只听见里面传来轻微的响动声。
他按捺不住心中的好奇，便打开了玉瓶，发现里面竟有几颗青色的药丸。
陆峰忍不住伸手拿出一颗，在手中摆弄起来。
“你干嘛！”

陆行舟刚一出来，就看见陆峰正拿着自己珍贵的凝气丹在手里把玩，顿时大声呵斥道。
他生怕陆峰弄坏了这来之不易的丹药。
陆峰被他这突如其来的呵斥吓了一跳，手一抖，那颗凝气丹直接从他手中滑落。
陆行舟见状，赶忙施展法术试图接住丹药，可终究还是晚了一步，丹药径直掉进了那锈迹斑斑的小鼎里面。
他赶忙快步走过去，轻轻把陆峰往旁边一拉，随即弯腰在小鼎里寻找那颗丹药。
陆峰见陆行舟如此紧张，心里明白自己肯定闯了大祸，眼睛瞬间泛红，低着头，不敢发出一点声音。
陆行舟急忙把小鼎倒扣过来，可却没有发现丹药的踪影。
他赶忙放开神识，仔细在房间里搜寻，可找遍了每一个角落，依旧不见丹药的一丝踪迹。
他明明亲眼看到丹药掉进了小鼎，可此刻却怎么也找不到。
这丹药的莫名消失，让他心疼得在滴血，同时也充满了疑惑。
陆峰见陆行舟这样，心中明白，那药丸对陆行舟肯定很重要。
他赶忙道歉：“哥哥，对不起，等日后我赚了钱，赔你。”
陆行舟脸上的怒意，被他强行压了下去。
他轻叹了口气。
“小弟，咱自家兄弟还好说，可你若是在别处这般乱动他人东西，怕是连开口的机会都没有。”
陆行舟一边对着陆峰嘱咐，一边伸手拿出测灵盘，说道：“把手放这上面。”
陆峰听后，唯唯诺诺的将手放在了测灵盘上。
刹那间，测灵盘上赫然亮起褐色与绿色两道光芒。
这突如其来的亮光，吓得陆峰猛的缩回了手。
而陆行舟则满脸不可思议之色。
content_en:
Lu Xingzhou turned to look at Lu Feng, his expression becoming friendly.
"Since your age meets the testing requirements, I will take you for a spiritual root test."
After saying that, he turned around and walked towards Linglong Pavilion.
Lu Feng's eyes instantly flashed with surprise and gratitude, and he quickly trotted to follow.
"Wait here for a moment, I'll be back soon." Lu Xingzhou turned to Lu Feng and said.
Then he came to another room.
I saw a faint aura flowing through the light curtain in front of the door, with runes faintly flickering at the edges.
A set of first-grade intermediate defense formations are arranged here to protect important objects in the room.
Lu Xingzhou gathered his breath and concentrated his energy, injecting a trace of spiritual power into the light screen.
The light curtain rippled slightly, then slowly opened a gap, and he stepped into it.
The space in the room is not large. There is only a simple altar with a soul measuring board placed on it.
This soul-measuring plate is a first-level high-grade magic weapon and can only be used for spiritual root testing.
But in order to purchase it, the Lu family also spent more than two hundred spiritual stones, which is considered a high-value item in the Lu family.
When Lu Feng saw that Lu Xingzhou had not returned for a long time, he began to look at everything around him curiously.
After all, at just six years old, he is full of curiosity about things he has never seen before.
He saw an exquisite jade vase on the table and couldn't help but pick it up and look at it carefully.
After looking at it for a long time, I couldn't figure out the reason. I put the jade bottle to my ear and shook it gently, only to hear a slight noise coming from inside.
Unable to suppress his curiosity, he opened the jade bottle and found several green pills inside.
Lu Feng couldn't help but reached out and took out one, playing with it in his hand.
"What are you doing!"
As soon as Lu Xingzhou came out, he saw Lu Feng playing with his precious Qi Condensing Pill in his hand, and he immediately shouted loudly.
He was afraid that Lu Feng would destroy the hard-won elixir.
Lu Feng was startled by his sudden scolding. His hand shook, and the Qi Condensing Pill slipped directly from his hand.
Seeing this, Lu Xingzhou quickly cast a spell to try to catch the elixir, but in the end it was too late, and the elixir fell straight into the rusty cauldron.
He hurriedly walked over, gently pulled Lu Feng aside, and then bent down to look for the pill in the small cauldron.
Seeing Lu Xingzhou being so nervous, Lu Feng knew in his heart that he must have caused a big disaster. His eyes instantly turned red, and he lowered his head, not daring to make a sound.
Lu Xingzhou hurriedly turned the small tripod upside down, but found no trace of the pill.
He quickly let go of his consciousness and searched the room carefully, but after searching every corner, there was still no trace of the elixir.
He clearly saw the elixir falling into the small cauldron with his own eyes, but he couldn't find it at this moment.
The inexplicable disappearance of this elixir made him bleed with heartache and full of doubts.
Seeing Lu Xingzhou like this, Lu Feng knew in his heart that the pill must be very important to Lu Xingzhou.
He quickly apologized: "Brother, I'm sorry. I will compensate you when I make money in the future."
He suppressed the anger on Lu Xingzhou's face.
He sighed.
"Little brother, it's okay for our own brothers, but if you were to mess with other people's things like this elsewhere, I'm afraid you wouldn't even have a chance to speak."
While Lu Xingzhou was giving instructions to Lu Feng, he stretched out his hand to take out the soul measuring board and said, "Put your hand on this."
After Lu Feng heard this, he placed his hand on the spirit board obediently.
In an instant, two rays of brown and green light suddenly lit up on the Ouija board.
Lu Feng was so frightened by the sudden light that he retracted his hand.
Lu Xingzhou, on the other hand, had a look of disbelief on his face.
